Markets.title: US stocks: Nasdaq ends sharply lower as hot inflation data stirs rate-hike worries
Markets.summary: The Nasdaq index closed sharply lower after September US inflation data showed an unexpected increase driven by higher gasoline costs and broader price pressures. This inflation report sparked concerns over potential interest rate hikes, causing significant declines in major AI-related stocks like Oracle and CoreWeave.

Markets.title: BlackRock, SBI MF lead Tonbo Imaging’s Rs 255 crore anchor round ahead of IPO
Markets.summary: Tonbo Imaging raised Rs 255 crore from anchor investors led by BlackRock and SBI Mutual Fund ahead of its Rs 852 crore initial public offering. The entirely offer-for-sale public issue prices its shares at Rs 700 each and runs from October 15 to October 19.

Markets.title: US stocks: AI shares tumble up to 16%, erasing $80 billion as hot US inflation fuels rate fears
Markets.summary: Major AI firms like CoreWeave and Dell saw their stock prices drop by up to 16%, erasing $80 billion in market value. This sell-off was driven by rising US inflation and interest rate fears, which have heightened investor concerns about the borrowing costs for less profitable sector companies.

Markets.title: BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, Nomura among key investors as Zetwerk mops up Rs 2,251 crore in anchor bidding; IPO opens on Oct 15
Markets.summary: Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses raised Rs 2,251 crore from 99 anchor investors, including BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, and Nomura, ahead of its IPO. The Rs 5,012 crore public issue opens on October 15 and closes on October 19 at a price band of Rs 143 to Rs 151 per share.

Markets.title: US Fed’s Bowman sees no urgency for another rate hike
Markets.summary: US Federal Reserve Vice Chair Michelle Bowman stated there is no immediate need for more interest rate hikes following a recent increase to a 3.75%-4.00% target range. She also emphasized the need for stronger bank oversight during the IMF-World Bank meetings in Bangkok.

Markets.title: Jio IPO sparks investor buzz: GMP rises to 20% as Reliance’s telecom arm announces price band, dates
Markets.summary: Jio Platforms has announced a Rs 30,213 crore IPO with a price band upper limit of Rs 1,119, making it India's largest-ever public issue. Ahead of the October 21 opening, the grey market premium rose to Rs 220, reflecting a nearly 20% investor premium.

Geo-Political.title: Musk says any limits on Ukraine's Starlink access down to US, not his firm
Geo-Political.summary: Elon Musk stated that any restrictions on Ukraine's Starlink satellite internet access are decided by the United States government rather than his company. Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials reported that while their access has improved, ongoing speed limits continue to disrupt battlefield operations.

Geo-Political.title: Student protesters attack government buildings in Tirana
Geo-Political.summary: Thousands of students in Albania are protesting in Tirana to demand better university conditions and job prospects. During the unrest, some protesters attacked and set fire to government buildings.

Geo-Political.title: Pope walking and recovering 'as expected' after surgery, doctors say
Geo-Political.summary: Doctors report that the 71-year-old Pope is walking and recovering as expected following a 90-minute surgery. He was diagnosed with lung cancer after the Tuesday procedure.

Geo-Political.title: US inflation rises more than expected - here's what is happening with prices
Geo-Political.summary: US inflation accelerated to 3.7% in the year leading up to September. This unexpected price increase was primarily driven by higher costs for motor fuel.

Geo-Political.title: Germany puts Ukrainian on trial accused of blowing up Nord Stream pipelines
Geo-Political.summary: Four years after the attacks, a Ukrainian man named Serhii Kuznetsov is on trial in Germany. He is accused of plotting to blow up Russia's Nord Stream gas pipelines.

Geo-Political.title: Australia's first-ever Michelin stars go to 11 restaurants in one state
Geo-Political.summary: Eleven restaurants in South Australia received Australia's first-ever Michelin stars. The state government reportedly paid incognito Michelin inspectors to visit the region.

AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator recently discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best course in that category. This traffic was generated without any paid advertising or traditional search engine optimization.

AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights ten advanced artificial intelligence tools used across various industries to automate repetitive tasks and boost productivity. These widely adopted technologies are designed to improve overall workflow and suit a variety of business applications.

Data & Insights.title: India Inc employee attrition rises to 18% in 2026; AI is changing how companies manage talent, shows new study
Data & Insights.summary: India's employee attrition rate increased to 18% in 2026 from 16.2% in 2025 despite stable salary budgets. A new study shows that artificial intelligence is also transforming how companies manage their talent.

Data & Insights.title: ‘Board of directors is expanding’: Jaishankar pitches bigger role for ‘middle powers’ in changing global order
Data & Insights.summary: Indian External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar has called for an expanded role for "middle powers" in the changing global order. This proposal follows a similar call by Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney for middle powers to unite in response to the decline of the US-led rules-based order.

Data & Insights.title: Piyush Goyal on China ties: India is ready to rebuild economic relations, but there's a catch
Data & Insights.summary: India's Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal stated that the country is open to rebuilding economic relations with China. However, he emphasized that any renewed engagement must guarantee fair terms, business continuity, and geopolitical stability.

Data & Insights.title: Why IMF’s growth upgrade for India doesn’t tell the full story
Data & Insights.summary: The IMF raised India's 2026-27 GDP growth forecast to 7 percent based on strong domestic momentum. However, currency depreciation reduced its nominal dollar GDP, temporarily dropping India behind the UK to sixth place globally.

Data & Insights.title: Wholesale inflation rises to 11.39% in September on jump in fuel, food, manufactured products prices
Data & Insights.summary: Wholesale inflation in India accelerated to 11.39% in September due to higher prices for fuel, food, and manufactured products. Specifically, the combined food index increased to 8.66% in September from 7.05% in August.

Data & Insights.title: Fixing current account deficit key to stablizing rupee: BCG's Janmejaya Sinha
Data & Insights.summary: India's current account deficit is primarily driven by imports of oil, gas, and gold. Fixing this deficit is essential for stabilizing the rupee, according to BCG India Chairman Janmejaya Sinha.

India.title: Man Kills Lover, Burns Body With Room Heater Over Marriage Demand
India.summary: Javed, an AC technician from Jalgaon district, murdered his female lover after she demanded they get married. He then disposed of her body by burning it with a room heater.

India.title: Wife, Lover 'Cried Uncontrollably' After Death Sentence In Blue Drum Murder
India.summary: Convicts Sahil Shukla and Muskan Rastogi were assigned new prisoner numbers and placed in separate cells following their death sentences for the Blue Drum murder. Jail authorities have increased security and are closely monitoring their condition after they cried uncontrollably upon hearing the verdict.

India.title: Cross-Border Racket Busted, Woman Among 2 Arrested With 8 kg Heroin In Punjab
India.summary: Punjab police arrested a woman and another individual for operating a cross-border smuggling racket. Authorities seized eight kilograms of heroin valued at over Rs 40 crore from the suspects.

India.title: Costlier Food, Fuel Drive September Wholesale Inflation To Record 11.39%
India.summary: Wholesale inflation in India reached a record 11.39 percent in September due to higher food and fuel costs. Specifically, inflation in the fuel and power basket rose to 25.85 percent from 22.93 percent in the previous month.

India.title: Surat Medical Shop Owner Sold Animal Product As Tonic For Children, Arrested
India.summary: A Surat medical shop owner was arrested for selling a veterinary feed supplement as a health tonic for children. The accused allegedly repacked large cans of the animal product into smaller 60 ml and 100 ml bottles.

India.title: 'No One Will Be Spared': Bhagwant Mann On Punjab Anti-Drug Activist's Murder
India.summary: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann vowed that no one will be spared in the murder case of an anti-drug activist. He reaffirmed the government's zero-tolerance policy, stating that influential drug peddlers will be prosecuted to protect the youth.

General.title: Musk says any limits on Ukraine's Starlink access down to US, not his firm
General.summary: Elon Musk stated that any restrictions on Ukraine's access to Starlink are decided by the United States government rather than his company. Meanwhile, Ukrainian officials reported that while their Starlink connection has improved, ongoing speed limits continue to disrupt battlefield operations.

General.title: We are behind you and that will not change, PM tells Zelensky
General.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy visited London to strengthen European support after a disagreement with Donald Trump. During the visit, the British Prime Minister assured him that the UK's backing remains unwavering.

General.title: Russell Brand was a 'sexual predator', prosecution alleges as rape trial begins
General.summary: Actor and comedian Russell Brand is on trial after being accused of acting as a "sexual predator." He has pleaded not guilty to three counts of rape, three counts of sexual assault, and one count of indecent assault.

General.title: Sally Rooney books withdrawn in UK over Palestine Action support
General.summary: Books by Irish author Sally Rooney have been withdrawn in the UK due to her support for Palestine Action. Rooney is well known for writing novels including Normal People, Intermezzo, and Conversations With Friends.

General.title: Drop-off charges at UK airports to be reviewed after sharp increase
General.summary: The UK government is reviewing airport drop-off charges following a sharp increase in fees. Officials stated the review aims to ensure travel remains accessible and passengers are treated fairly.

General.title: Reform faces criticism after councillors filmed making racist comments
General.summary: Reform is facing criticism after councillors were filmed making racist comments. The party stated that all individuals involved have resigned or been suspended and are currently under investigation.
